items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Otto of Haasburg, you certainly know of him?

ctx.x: I was standing in the corridor at the window, looking out and everybody -- there was quite a mob, so naturally, they were coming to meet -- this was a reception for the Haasburg, whom I found out later, was probably traveling incognito, I don't know.
